policy_condition: A durable governance checkpoint is required, so fused_governed_pipeline is infeasible before cost comparison.
selection_rationale: Earlier frozen development results bracket the crossover between q=0.05 and q=0.20. The complete intermediate grid is fixed before observing any intermediate timing and crosses width and policy selectivity without selecting favorable cells.
failure_policy: Do not train a multifactor checkpoint optimizer. If a global query-selectivity threshold solves the frozen grid, retain it as the strongest simple rule and stop adding model complexity.
success_policy: Authorize development of an interpretable p-q-width checkpoint cost boundary. This does not authorize a paper claim or access to a new real-data holdout.
